summary: A failed worker attempt at a human_checkpoint step has a declared recovery: the engine admits record_worker_failure there as a hold-mode recovery that keeps the pinned definition digest, and the recorded failure dispositions the attempt, so the operator's own gate opens. The checkpoint hold keys on attempts a worker actually dispatched and releases on the accept, the record, or a later actual dispatch, so a dispatch window no worker used dispositions nothing, while every other step keeps the CD-0133 timing. Amends CD-0187 D2 and D3.
title: CD-0187 D2 and D3 release the checkpoint gate at the recorded failure, and an unused dispatch window holds
